Description: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Changelog: The Database settings page has a new "Updater" section. Besides updating all characters, you can now choose "Update stale characters" to only log into characters not seen within a set number of days (default 7). Characters only spotted on the character select screen and never logged into also count as stale. A preview shows how many will be logged in and how many will be skipped before you start. The "Export CSV" button now sits right below the database checkboxes.
